units.text: EXT. HOLLOW OAK GLADE - TWILIGHT
An oak older than the kingdom, hollowed by lightning and furred with moss.
Fireflies drift between roots as thick as cottages.
The sky is violet, and the first stars hang low, like lanterns on unseen strings.
An old WITCH, SIBYLLE ORMONDE (70s), sits on a stump.
Her cloak is the color of crow feathers.
She stirs a small iron pot hung from a tripod, and the smoke rises in spirals that briefly resemble faces.
Before her stands a boy, FINNEGAN BRAE (12), barefoot, gripping a lantern with both hands.
She does not look up.
He clears his throat.
I came for the cure.
units.name: FINNEGAN

units.text: Did you.
units.name: SIBYLLE

units.text: She dips a wooden spoon and tastes.
Her mouth puckers.
She lets him wait.
My sister has a fever. The healers said you could help.
units.name: FINNEGAN

units.text: The healers say a great many things.
units.name: SIBYLLE

units.text: She sets the spoon aside, rises with a creak of old bones, and circles him slowly, as one circles a horse at market.
What have you brought?
units.name: SIBYLLE

units.text: Silver. Three coins.
units.name: FINNEGAN

units.text: Silver is for fools. What else?
units.name: SIBYLLE

units.text: He hesitates.
His fingers tighten on the lantern.
Then he reaches into his tunic and draws out a small bone whistle, yellowed with age.
My father's.
units.name: FINNEGAN

units.text: Her eyes sharpen.
She plucks it from his palm and turns it in the firelight.
For a long moment, she says nothing, and the fireflies pause in the air.
Where did you get this?
units.name: SIBYLLE

units.text: He left it. When he went to the war.
units.name: FINNEGAN

units.text: And did he return?
units.name: SIBYLLE

units.text: He shakes his head.
She presses the whistle back into his hand and folds his fingers over it.
Keep it. A cure costs less than you fear.
units.name: SIBYLLE

units.text: She ladles the dark brew into a clay vial, stoppers it with wax, and presses it into his other palm.
He stares at it, then at her, and bows his head.
Thank you.
units.name: FINNEGAN

units.text: Go home. Before the moon is full.
units.name: SIBYLLE

units.text: He turns and runs.
The lantern bobs between the roots and fades.
She watches until the last glimmer is gone, then lowers herself onto the stump and picks up the whistle's twin from her own pocket, and holds the two together.
